text:
Maria: Quick sync — sharing the weekly checkpoint for the Optimize toolkit rollout. Need owners for remaining items and any blockers. TL;DR: quant recs done, batching in review, cache infra blocked.

Raj: I own quantization recommendation docs + the PR. PR: https://github.com/redwood/optkit/pull/678 — awaiting final perf numbers from eng-runtime. I can merge once CI green.

Gabe: Batching changes are gated on the kernel selector change, I put up a draft RFC earlier today. RFC: https://go/redwood/rfcs/optkit-batching-kernel-selector. Code review pinged @Raj for the compatibility checks.

Jen: Cache integration (prefix/KV caching) is blocked by the VPC NAT rule change from infra (ticket INF-332). Eng-infra said ETA Thurs. Without NAT, cache fetches to hosted index fail intermittently.

Omar: FYI we got a regression alert from the evals job on embeddings-quality suite — job 452. Failing test is `embed_cosine_stability` on quantized fp16 path. Repro steps: 
```
pytest tests/evals/test_embeddings.py::test_embed_cosine_stability -k quant_fp16 --runslow
```
Stack trace attached to ticket EVAL-452.

Raj: Thanks @Omar — I can take a look after lunch. Likely related to a different kernel fallback we added. If we need to rollback quant profile, we should coordinate with Gabe so batching doesn't break.

Gabe: If the regression is in the fp16 path, we can gate that profile behind a flag and let non-quantized users continue. I'll add a feature flag in the runtime and a rollout plan in the PR.

Maria: Owners summary: Raj -> quant recs + fix regression, Gabe -> batching + feature flag, Jen -> cache integration + infra follow-up. Omar -> regression triage + evals. Can each of you confirm ETA for your next action?

Raj: ETAs: debug + patch for regression by EOD tomorrow (1839587523). Will post a small PR for the kernel fallback change.

Gabe: ETA for feature-flagged rollout + CI updates: Friday COB (1839734400). Need help from CI to add a flaky test marker for the failing embedding test until Raj's patch lands.

Jen: Will follow up with infra on INF-332 this afternoon, but provisional ETA Thu noon (1839638400). If infra slips, we might need a short-lived mock cache shim.

Omar: I'll attach detailed repro logs to EVAL-452 and try a bisect against the quant commit range tonight. ETA for triage: tomorrow morning.

ci-bot: Build #1124 started for PR 678. Status: pending.

deploy-bot: FYI: Dedicated pool capacity check passed for canary region, no capacity constraints reported.

Maria: Two coordination asks: 1) Raj/Gabe sync today on the kernel change intersection (15-30m). 2) Jen/Omar sync if infra blocks cache so we can run with a shim. Please react when you can do the 15m.

Gabe: I can do a slot at 4pm PT. :thumbsup:

Raj: 4pm PT works for me.

Jen: I can do 4pm PT too.

Omar: I have an async window — will join if triage finishes. Otherwise I'll follow up in-thread.

Maria: Great. Also, quick CR ping: please review PR 678 and leave at least one approving comment before EOD Wed, so we can unblock the Optimize toolkit doc release.

Raj: Noted. I'll add the fix and request final review.

Gabe: Reviewing now, adding comments.

Jen: Will skim docs after infra check.

Maria: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for blockers/owners. If anything changes, update here rather than new threads. :heart:

(End of thread)
